name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: Transactional Agent middleware built on the CodeJam starter kit and ModelArk.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:scripts: node --check scripts/run-local-poc.mjs && bash -n scripts/start-local-poc.sh && node --test scripts/run-local-poc.test.mjs
scripts.check:phase0: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:phase2: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm audit
